title: Publish check: a story picture must be hosted by us (per publication setting)
description: Add a checklist/lens check (and a per-publication setting, off by default so existing sites are unchanged, on for Machines on Machines) that flags a story whose cover picture or body pictures point at an address that is not our own storage or the site's own host: plain words, names the picture, points at the localise operation. Severity per the story procedure rules (error when the setting is on). Applies to social preview images too (og:image and twitter:image come from the cover). Gherkin: external cover flagged, own path passes, setting off does not flag. Depends on the localise story.
